lines.text: This QR code lost a corner, and it still scans.
Every QR code carries extra recovery data: error correction.
If squares get torn or dirty, the scanner rebuilds the missing data.
Level L recovers about seven percent of its data; level H, about thirty.
But error correction can't fix the three corner squares scanners look for.
Printing one? Choose a higher level, and keep those corners clear.
